data.name: Mujab
data.gender_notes: Mujab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gathers or collects. A warrior who collects victories and a gem that is gathered and treasured. The name Mujab carries the meaning “Gatherer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mujab usually hope their child will grow to embody gatherer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the courage and determination to gather knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Mujab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gatherer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mujab total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مجاب
in_arabic.meaning: منافقین سے بچایا گیا، مجبور یا زبردستی کیا گیا
in_arabic.long_meaning: مجاب نام کا مطلب ہے جو منافقین سے بچایا گیا ہے یا مجبور کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور قرآن مجید میں جگہ رکھتا ہے۔ مجاب کا تعلق عربی جڑ 'ج-و-ب' سے ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'جواب دینا' یا 'منافقین سے بچانا'۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو سچے اور راستباز ہیں۔

in_urdu.name: مجاب

in_hindi.name: मुजाब
in_hindi.meaning: मुनाफिकों से बचाया गया, मजबूर या जबरदस्ती किया गया
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुजाब नाम का अर्थ है जो मुनाफिकों से बचाया गया है या मजबूर किया गया है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से निकला है और इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्व रखता है। मुजाब का संबंध अरबी जड़ 'ज-व-ब' से है जिसका अर्थ है 'जवाब देना' या 'मुनाफिकों से बचाना'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम सच्चाई और راستबाजी की प्रतीक के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مجاب
in_pashto.meaning: د منافقينو څخه ژغورل شوی، مجبور یا زبر ځواک
in_pashto.long_meaning: مجاب نوم معنی دے چې د منافقينو څخه ژغورل شوی دی یا مجبور شوی دی۔ دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه راغلی دی او د افغانستان په اسلامی روایت کې ځای لري۔ مجاب د عربي ريښې 'ج-و-ب' څخه اړوند دی چې د 'ځواب ورکول' یا 'منافقينو څخه ژغورل' معنی لري. په پښتنو او افغان دود کې، دا نوم د راستيا او صداقت نښه په توګه کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Mujab
in_english.meaning: Protected from hypocrites, compelled or forced
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mujab means protected from hypocrites or compelled. It originates from the Arabic language and holds significance in Islamic tradition. Mujab is derived from the Arabic root 'ج-و-ب' which means 'to respond' or 'to protect from hypocrites'. In Islamic culture, this name is associated with truthfulness, righteousness, and protection from deceit. Historically, it has been used to signify a person who is genuine and upright.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mujab carries a sense of strength and determination in its cultural context. It implies a warrior or a fighter who is constantly collecting wins, achievements, and victories. This can translate to various aspects of life, including personal and professional pursuits, competitive sports, or even political and military struggles.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mujab also holds profound spiritual meaning, representing a spiritual warrior who collects and treasures valuable spiritual gems. These gems could take the form of beautiful virtues, deep knowledge of God, or practices that draw us closer to our Creator.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gatherer" symbolizes The one who gathers or collects. A warrior who collects victories and a gem that is gathered and treasured.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mujab serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gatherer.
